title: タンク付き可搬式空気圧縮機
description: 屋外の補修作業や管理庫向けの車輪付き空気圧縮機。横置き受気タンク、電動機、放熱フィン付き圧縮部、圧力計、調圧器、排水弁と運搬ハンドルを造形。ホース、圧縮空気、可動・電気機能はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.855 × 0.800 × 0.579 m、19,408三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A wheeled air compressor for outdoor maintenance and service sheds. Includes a horizontal receiver tank, motor, finned pump, gauge, regulator, drain valve and transport handle. No hose, compressed air, electrical operation or moving mechanism is supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.855 × 0.800 × 0.579 m; 19,408 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
